paraphrase: Open premise: the reduced nominal description suffices for the name 'God' to apply. If a being is the only being maximal in being and causes the being of every other being, it is the one the Summa calls God. The source descriptions add 'remote from all' (q.13 a.8 ad 2) and 'cause of goodness and every perfection' (quarta via); this premise drops them.
